title: DDAGCraft
body:
![DDAG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f7966079d61d22b3935427919499b94c61ea618.png)# DDAG Craft

**DDAG Craft** is a large-scale industrial modpack built around **Create**, designed for players who enjoy automation, logistics, engineering, and exploration.

Build massive factories, establish railway networks, create automated production lines, construct airships, and expand your industrial empire across an enhanced and immersive world.

## ✨ Main Features

⚙️ **Create Ecosystem**

* Create 6
* Create: Aeronautics
* Steam 'n' Rails
* Factory Logistics
* Diesel Generators
* Ender Transmission
* Mechanical Extruder
* Big Cannons
* Numismatics
* And many more Create add-ons

✈️ **Airships & Transportation**
Take automation beyond the ground with fully functional airships powered by Create: Aeronautics. Build airports, cargo terminals, flying factories, and connect distant settlements through the skies.

🚂 **Industrial Logistics**
Design efficient railway systems, automated warehouses, delivery networks, and large-scale production facilities using dozens of Create integrations.

🌍 **Enhanced World Generation**
Explore a completely redesigned world featuring:

* Terralith
* Tectonic
* Incendium
* Nullscape
* Explorify
* Additional Structures
* YUNG's structure overhauls
* Better Villages
* Dungeons & Taverns
  and many more structures waiting to be discovered.

🏗️ **Building & Decoration**
Hundreds of decorative blocks, furniture, copycats, factories, bridges, interiors, and architectural additions let you build everything from small villages to giant industrial cities.

🍳 **Farming & Cooking**
Expand your survival experience with Farmer's Delight and a carefully selected collection of food and farming add-ons.

💻 **Computer Automation**
Program computers and automation systems using CC: Tweaked and Advanced Peripherals to create intelligent factories, monitoring systems, railway control centers, and industrial dashboards.

🎮 **Multiplayer Ready**
Designed with multiplayer in mind:

* Team support
* Land claiming
* Voice chat
* Shared logistics
* Trading systems
* Optimized server performance

⚡ **Performance**
The modpack includes a carefully selected set of optimization mods such as ModernFix, FerriteCore, C2ME, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, Sodium, Iris and many more to provide smooth gameplay despite its large content size.

Whether you want to build a sprawling industrial metropolis, command a fleet of airships, automate every aspect of production, or simply explore a beautiful world, DDAG Craft provides a complete Create experience.
